verses.sa: अतिसृष्टो अपां वृषभोऽतिसृष्टा अग्नयो दिव्याः ॥
verses.rom: atisrishto apam vrishabho'tisrishta agnayo divyah ||
verses.en: Let go [is] the bull of the waters; let go [are] the heavenly fires.

verses.sa: रुजन् परिरुजन् मृणन् प्रमृणन् ॥
verses.rom: rujan parirujan mrinan pramrinan ||
verses.en: Breaking, breaking about, killing, slaughtering;—

verses.sa: म्रोको मनोहा खनो निर्दाह आत्मदूषिस्तनूदूषिः ॥
verses.rom: mroko manoha khano nirdaha atmadushistanudushih ||
verses.en: Dimming mroká, mind-slaying, digging, out-burning, self-spoiling, body-spoiling.

verses.sa: इदं तमति सृजामि तं माभ्यवनिक्षि ॥
verses.rom: idam tamati srijami tam mabhyavanikshi ||
verses.en: That one now I let go; that one let me not wash down against myself;—

verses.sa: तेन तमभ्यतिसृजामो योऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मः ॥
verses.rom: tena tamabhyatisrijamo yo'sman dveshti yam vayam dvishmah ||
verses.en: That one do we let go against him who hates us, whom we hate.

verses.sa: अपामग्रमसि समुद्रं वोऽभ्यवसृजामि ॥
verses.rom: apamagramasi samudram vo'bhyavasrijami ||
verses.en: Thou art tip (ágra) of the waters; I let you go down unto the ocean.

verses.sa: योऽप्स्वग्निरति तं सृजामि म्रोकं खनिं तनूदूषिम् ॥
verses.rom: yo'psvagnirati tam srijami mrokam khanim tanudushim ||
verses.en: The fire that is in the waters, it do I let go, the dimming, digging, body-spoiling one.

verses.sa: यो व आपोऽग्निराविवेश स एष यद्वो घोरं तदेतत् ॥
verses.rom: yo va apo'gniravivesha sa esha yadvo ghoram tadetat ||
verses.en: The fire that entered into you, O waters, this is that; what of you is terrible, this is that.

verses.sa: इन्द्रस्य व इन्द्रियेणाभि षिञ्चेत् ॥
verses.rom: indrasya va indriyenabhi shinchet ||
verses.en: May [it] pour upon you with Indra's Indra-power (indriyá).

verses.sa: अरिप्रा आपो अप रिप्रमस्मत् ॥
verses.rom: aripra apo apa ripramasmat ||
verses.en: Free from defilement (-riprá) [are] the waters; let them [carry] away from us defilement;—

verses.sa: प्रास्मदेनो वहन्तु प्र दुष्वप्न्यं वहन्तु ॥
verses.rom: prasmadeno vahantu pra dushvapnyam vahantu ||
verses.en: Let them carry forth from us sin; let them carry forth evil-dreaming.

verses.sa: शिवेन मा चक्षुषा पश्यतापः शिवया तन्वोप स्पृशत त्वचं मे ॥
verses.rom: shivena ma chakshusha pashyatapah shivaya tanvopa sprishata tvacham me ||
verses.en: With propitious eye look at me, O waters; with propitious body touch my skin.

verses.sa: शिवान् अग्नीन् अप्सुषदो हवामहे मयि क्षत्रं वर्च आ धत्त देवीः ॥
verses.rom: shivan agnin apsushado havamahe mayi kshatram varcha a dhatta devih ||
verses.en: We call the propitious fires that sit in the waters. Put in me dominion [and] splendor, O divine [waters].

verses.sa: निर्दुरर्मण्य ऊर्जा मधुमती वाक् ॥
verses.rom: nirdurarmanya urja madhumati vak ||
verses.en: Out of evil-eating (?) with refreshment [comes] speech rich in honey.

verses.sa: मधुमती स्थ मधुमतीं वाचमुदेयम् ॥
verses.rom: madhumati stha madhumatim vachamudeyam ||
verses.en: Rich in honey are ye; may I speak speech rich in honey.

verses.sa: उपहूतो मे गोपाः उपहूतो गोपीथः ॥
verses.rom: upahuto me gopah upahuto gopithah ||
verses.en: Invoked of me [is] the guardian (gopā́); invoked [is] guardianship.

verses.sa: सुश्रुतौ कर्णौ भद्रश्रुतौ कर्णौ भद्रं श्लोकं श्रूयासम् ॥
verses.rom: sushrutau karnau bhadrashrutau karnau bhadram shlokam shruyasam ||
verses.en: Well-hearing ears, ears hearing what is excellent; may I hear excellent encomium (çlóka).

verses.sa: सुश्रुतिश्च मोपश्रुतिश्च मा हासिष्टां सौपर्णं चक्षुरजस्रं ज्योतिः ॥
verses.rom: sushrutishcha mopashrutishcha ma hasishtam sauparnam chakshurajasram jyotih ||
verses.en: Let both well-hearing and listening (úpaçruti) not desert me—eagle-like sight, unfailing light.

verses.sa: ऋषीणां प्रस्तरोऽसि नमोऽस्तु दैवाय प्रस्तराय ॥
verses.rom: rishinam prastaro'si namo'stu daivaya prastaraya ||
verses.en: Spread (prastará) of the seers art thou; homage be to the spread of the divine ones (dāíva).

verses.sa: मूर्धाहं रयीणां मूर्धा समानानां भूयासम् ॥
verses.rom: murdhaham rayinam murdha samananam bhuyasam ||
verses.en: May I be the head (mūrdhán) of riches, the head of my equals.

verses.sa: रुजश्च मा वेनश्च मा हासिष्टां मूर्धा च मा विधर्मा च मा हासिष्टाम् ॥
verses.rom: rujashcha ma venashcha ma hasishtam murdha cha ma vidharma cha ma hasishtam ||
verses.en: Let both breaking (? rujá) and longing (vená) not desert me; let both the head (mūrdhán) and the distributer (? vídharman) not desert me.

verses.sa: उर्वश्च मा चमसश्च मा हासिष्टां धर्ता च मा धरुणश्च मा हासिष्टाम् ॥
verses.rom: urvashcha ma chamasashcha ma hasishtam dharta cha ma dharunashcha ma hasishtam ||
verses.en: Let both the kettle (?) and the cup (camasá) not desert me; let both the maintainer (dhartṛ́) and the supporter (dharúṇa) not desert me.

verses.sa: विमोकश्च मार्द्रपविश्च मा हासिष्टामार्द्रदानुश्च मा मातरिश्वा च मा हासिष्टाम् ॥
verses.rom: vimokashcha mardrapavishcha ma hasishtamardradanushcha ma matarishva cha ma hasishtam ||
verses.en: Let both the releaser (vimoká) and the wet-rimmed one not desert me; let both him of wet drops (-dā́nu) and Mātariçvan not desert me.

verses.sa: बृहस्पतिर्म आत्मा नृमणा नाम हृद्यः ॥
verses.rom: brihaspatirma atma nrimana nama hridyah ||
verses.en: Brihaspati my soul, manly-minded by name, hearty (hṛ́dya).

verses.sa: असंतापं मे हृदयमुर्वी गव्यूतिः समुद्रो अस्मि विधर्मणा ॥
verses.rom: asamtapam me hridayamurvi gavyutih samudro asmi vidharmana ||
verses.en: Free from torment my heart, a wide pasture, an ocean am I by extent (vídharman).

verses.sa: नाभिरहं रयीणां नाभिः समानानां भूयासम् ॥
verses.rom: nabhiraham rayinam nabhih samananam bhuyasam ||
verses.en: May I be the navel of riches, the navel of my equals.

verses.sa: स्वासदसि सूषा अमृतो मर्त्येश्वा ॥
verses.rom: svasadasi susha amrito martyeshva ||
verses.en: Of good seat (? svāsát) art thou, of good dawns, an immortal among mortals.

verses.sa: मा मां प्राणो हासीन् मो अपानोऽवहाय परा गात् ॥
verses.rom: ma mam prano hasin mo apano'vahaya para gat ||
verses.en: Let not breath quit me; nor let expiration, deserting me, go away.

verses.sa: सूर्यो माह्नः पात्वग्निः पृथिव्या वायुरन्तरिक्षाद्यमो मनुष्येभ्यः सरस्वती पार्थिवेभ्यः ॥
verses.rom: suryo mahnah patvagnih prithivya vayurantarikshadyamo manushyebhyah sarasvati parthivebhyah ||
verses.en: Let the sun protect me from the sky, Agni from the earth, Vāyu from the atmosphere, Yama from men (manuṣyà), Sarasvatī from them of the earth.

verses.sa: प्राणापनौ मा मा हासिष्टं मा जने प्र मेषि ॥
verses.rom: pranapanau ma ma hasishtam ma jane pra meshi ||
verses.en: O breath-and-expiration, do not desert me; let me not perish (pra-mī) among the people (jána).

verses.sa: स्वस्त्यद्योषसो दोषसश्च सर्व आपः सर्वगणो अशीय ॥
verses.rom: svastyadyoshaso doshasashcha sarva apah sarvagano ashiya ||
verses.en: With well-being today, O waters, may I, whole [and] with my whole train (-gaṇá), attain dawns and evenings.

verses.sa: शक्वरी स्थ पशवो मोप स्थेषुर्मित्रावरुणौ मे प्राणापानावग्निर्मे दक्षं दधातु ॥
verses.rom: shakvari stha pashavo mopa stheshurmitravarunau me pranapanavagnirme daksham dadhatu ||
verses.en: Puissant (çákvarī) are ye; may cattle approach me; let Mitra-and-Varuṇa [assign] me breath-and-expiration; let Agni assign me dexterity.

verses.sa:
विद्म ते स्वप्न जनित्रं ग्राह्याः पुत्रोऽसि यमस्य करणः ।
अन्तकोऽसि मृत्युरसि ।
तं त्वा स्वप्न तथा सं विद्म स नः स्वप्न दुष्वप्न्यात्पाहि ॥
verses.rom:
vidma te svapna janitram grahyah putro'si yamasya karanah |
antako'si mrityurasi |
tam tva svapna tatha sam vidma sa nah svapna dushvapnyatpahi ||
verses.en: 1. We know thy place of birth (janítra), O sleep; thou art son of seizure (grā́hi), agent of Yama; 2. ender art thou, death art thou; 3. so, O sleep, do we comprehend thee here; do thou, O sleep, protect us from evil-dreaming.

verses.sa:
विद्म ते स्वप्न जनित्रं निर्ऋत्याः पुत्रोऽसि यमस्य करणः ।
अन्तकोऽसि मृत्युरसि ।
तं त्वा स्वप्न तथा सं विद्म स नः स्वप्न दुष्वप्न्यात्पाहि ॥
verses.rom:
vidma te svapna janitram nirrityah putro'si yamasya karanah |
antako'si mrityurasi |
tam tva svapna tatha sam vidma sa nah svapna dushvapnyatpahi ||
verses.en: 4. We know thy place of birth, O sleep; thou art son of perdition, agent etc. etc.

verses.sa:
विद्म ते स्वप्न जनित्रमभूत्याः पुत्रोऽसि यमस्य करणः ।
अन्तकोऽसि मृत्युरसि ।
तं त्वा स्वप्न तथा सं विद्म स नः स्वप्न दुष्वप्न्यात्पाहि ॥
verses.rom:
vidma te svapna janitramabhutyah putro'si yamasya karanah |
antako'si mrityurasi |
tam tva svapna tatha sam vidma sa nah svapna dushvapnyatpahi ||
verses.en: 5. We know thy place of birth, O sleep; thou art son of ill-success (ábhūti), agent etc. etc.

verses.sa:
विद्म ते स्वप्न जनित्रं निर्भूत्याः पुत्रोऽसि यमस्य करणः ।
अन्तकोऽसि मृत्युरसि ।
तं त्वा स्वप्न तथा सं विद्म स नः स्वप्न दुष्वप्न्यात्पाहि ॥
verses.rom:
vidma te svapna janitram nirbhutyah putro'si yamasya karanah |
antako'si mrityurasi |
tam tva svapna tatha sam vidma sa nah svapna dushvapnyatpahi ||
verses.en: 6. We know thy place of birth, O sleep; thou art son of extermination (nírbhūti), agent etc. etc.

verses.sa:
विद्म ते स्वप्न जनित्रं पराभूत्याः पुत्रोऽसि यमस्य करणः ।
अन्तकोऽसि मृत्युरसि ।
तं त्वा स्वप्न तथा सं विद्म स नः स्वप्न दुष्वप्न्यात्पाहि ॥
verses.rom:
vidma te svapna janitram parabhutyah putro'si yamasya karanah |
antako'si mrityurasi |
tam tva svapna tatha sam vidma sa nah svapna dushvapnyatpahi ||
verses.en: 7. We know thy place of birth, O sleep; thou art son of calamity (párābhūti), agent etc. etc.

verses.sa:
विद्म ते स्वप्न जनित्रं देवजामीनां पुत्रोऽसि यमस्य करणः ।
अन्तकोऽसि मृत्युरसि ।
तं त्वा स्वप्न तथा सं विद्म स नः स्वप्न दुष्वप्न्यात्पाहि ॥
verses.rom:
vidma te svapna janitram devajaminam putro'si yamasya karanah |
antako'si mrityurasi |
tam tva svapna tatha sam vidma sa nah svapna dushvapnyatpahi ||
verses.en: 8. We know thy place of birth, O sleep; thou art son of the wives (-jāmí) of the gods, agent of Yama; 9. ender art thou, death art thou; 10. so, O sleep, do we comprehend thee here; do thou, O sleep, protect us from evil-dreaming.

verses.sa: अजैष्माद्यासनामद्यामूमनागसो वयम् ॥
verses.rom: ajaishmadyasanamadyamumanagaso vayam ||
verses.en: We have conquered today, we have won today; we have become guiltless.

verses.sa: उषो यस्माद्दुष्वप्न्यादभैष्माप तदुच्छतु ॥
verses.rom: usho yasmaddushvapnyadabhaishmapa taduchchhatu ||
verses.en: O dawn, of what evil-dreaming we have been afraid, let that fade away (apa-vas).

verses.sa: द्विषते तत्परा वह शपते तत्परा वह ॥
verses.rom: dvishate tatpara vaha shapate tatpara vaha ||
verses.en: Carry that away to him that hates; carry that away to him that curses.

verses.sa: यं द्विष्मो यश्च नो द्वेष्टि तस्मा एनद्गमयामः ॥
verses.rom: yam dvishmo yashcha no dveshti tasma enadgamayamah ||
verses.en: Whom we hate, and who hates us, to him we make it go.

verses.sa: उषा देवी वाचा संविदाना वाग्देव्युषसा संविदाना ॥
verses.rom: usha devi vacha samvidana vagdevyushasa samvidana ||
verses.en: Heavenly dawn, in concord with speech; heavenly speech, in concord with dawn;—

verses.sa: उषस्पतिर्वाचस्पतिना संविदानो वाचस्पतिना संविदानः ॥
verses.rom: ushaspatirvachaspatina samvidano vachaspatina samvidanah ||
verses.en: The lord of dawn, in concord with the lord of speech; the lord of speech, in concord with the lord of dawn:—

verses.sa: तेऽमुष्मै परा वहन्त्वरायान् दुर्णाम्नः सदान्वाः ॥
verses.rom: te'mushmai para vahantvarayan durnamnah sadanvah ||
verses.en: Let them carry away for yon man the niggards (arā́ya), the ill-named ones, the sadā́nvās,—

verses.sa: कुम्भीकाः दूषीकाः पीयकान् ॥
verses.rom: kumbhikah dushikah piyakan ||
verses.en: The kumbhī́kās, the spoilers (dūṣī́kā), the revilers (pī́yaka),—

verses.sa: जाग्रद्दुष्वप्न्यं स्वप्नेदुष्वप्न्यम् ॥
verses.rom: jagraddushvapnyam svapnedushvapnyam ||
verses.en: Waking evil-dreaming, sleeping evil-dreaming.

verses.sa: अनागमिष्यतो वरान् अवित्तेः संकल्पान् अमुच्या द्रुहः पाशान् ॥
verses.rom: anagamishyato varan avitteh samkalpan amuchya druhah pashan ||
verses.en: Boons that will not come, plans of non-acquisition, fetters of hatred that does not release:—

verses.sa: तदमुष्मा अग्ने देवाः परा वहन्तु वघ्रिर्यथासद्विथुरो न साधुः ॥
verses.rom: tadamushma agne devah para vahantu vaghriryathasadvithuro na sadhuh ||
verses.en: That, O Agni, let the gods carry away for yon man, that he may be impotent (vádhri), faltering, not good (sādhú).

verses.sa: तेनैनं विध्याम्यभूत्यैनं विध्यामि निर्भूत्यैनं विध्यामि पराभूत्यैनं विध्यामि ग्राह्यैनं विध्यामि तमसैनं विध्यामि ॥
verses.rom: tenainam vidhyamyabhutyainam vidhyami nirbhutyainam vidhyami parabhutyainam vidhyami grahyainam vidhyami tamasainam vidhyami ||
verses.en: With that I pierce him; with ill-success I pierce him; with extermination I pierce him; with calamity I pierce him; with seizure I pierce him; with darkness I pierce him.

verses.sa: देवानामेनं घोरैः क्रूरैः प्रैषैरभिप्रेष्यामि ॥
verses.rom: devanamenam ghoraih kruraih praishairabhipreshyami ||
verses.en: I demand against him with the terrible, cruel demands (prāiṣá) of the gods.

verses.sa: वैश्वानरस्यैनं दंष्ट्रयोरपि दधामि ॥
verses.rom: vaishvanarasyainam damshtrayorapi dadhami ||
verses.en: I set him in the two tusks of Vāiçvānara.

verses.sa: एवानेवाव सा गरत् ॥
verses.rom: evanevava sa garat ||
verses.en: So, not so, may she swallow down.

verses.sa: योऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि तमात्मा द्वेष्टु यं वयं द्विष्मः स आत्मानं द्वेष्टु ॥
verses.rom: yo'sman dveshti tamatma dveshtu yam vayam dvishmah sa atmanam dveshtu ||
verses.en: Whoso hates us, him let [his] self (ātmán) hate; whomso we hate, let him hate [his] self.}}

verses.sa: निर्द्विषन्तं दिवो निः पृथिव्या निरन्तरिक्षाद्भजाम ॥
verses.rom: nirdvishantam divo nih prithivya nirantarikshadbhajama ||
verses.en: Let us disportion our hater from heaven, from earth, from atmosphere.

verses.sa: सुयामंश्चाक्षुष ॥
verses.rom: suyamamshchakshusha ||
verses.en: O thou of good ways (suyāman), of sight (cākṣuṣá).

verses.sa: इदमहमामुष्यायणेऽमुष्याः पुत्रे दुष्वप्न्यं मृजे ॥
verses.rom: idamahamamushyayane'mushyah putre dushvapnyam mrije ||
verses.en: Now (idám) do I wipe off evil-dreaming on him of such-and-such lineage, son of such-and-such a mother.

verses.sa: यददोअदो अभ्यगछं यद्दोषा यत्पूर्वां रात्रिम् ॥
verses.rom: yadadoado abhyagachham yaddosha yatpurvam ratrim ||
verses.en: What I went at on such-and-such an occasion, what at evening, what in early night;—

verses.sa: यज्जाग्रद्यत्सुप्तो यद्दिवा यन् नक्तम् ॥
verses.rom: yajjagradyatsupto yaddiva yan naktam ||
verses.en: What when awake, what when asleep, what by day, what by night;—

verses.sa: यदहरहरभिगछामि तस्मादेनमव दये ॥
verses.rom: yadaharaharabhigachhami tasmadenamava daye ||
verses.en: What day by day I go at, from that do I cut him off (ava-day).

verses.sa: तं जहि तेन मन्दस्व तस्य पृष्टीरपि शृणीहि ॥
verses.rom: tam jahi tena mandasva tasya prishtirapi shrinihi ||
verses.en: Him do thou smite, with him amuse thyself (? mand), his ribs do thou crush in.

verses.sa: स मा जीवीत्तं प्राणो जहातु ॥
verses.rom: sa ma jivittam prano jahatu ||
verses.en: Let him not live; him let breath quit.

verses.sa: जितमस्माकमुद्भिन्नमस्माकमृतमस्माकं तेजसस्माकं ब्रह्मास्माकं स्वरस्माकं यज्ञोऽस्माकं पशवोऽस्माकं प्रजा अस्माकं वीरा अस्माकम् ॥
verses.rom: jitamasmakamudbhinnamasmakamritamasmakam tejasasmakam brahmasmakam svarasmakam yajno'smakam pashavo'smakam praja asmakam vira asmakam ||
verses.en: 1. Ours [is] what is conquered, ours what has shot up, ours right (ṛtá), ours brilliancy, ours bráhman, ours heaven (svàr), ours the sacrifice, ours cattle, ours progeny, ours heroes. 2. From that we disportion him yonder: so-and-so, of such-and-such lineage, son of such-and-such mother, who is yonder; 3. let him not be released from the fetter of seizure. 4. Of him now (idám) I involve the splendor, brilliancy, breath, lifetime; now I make him fall downward.

jitamasmakamudbhinnamasmakamritamasmakam tejo'smakam brahmasmakam svarasmakam yajno'smakam pashavo'smakam praja asmakam vira asmakam |
tasmadamum nirbhajamo'mumamushyayanamamushyah putramasau yah |
so'horatrayoh pashan ma mochi ||
verses.en: 24. Ours is etc. etc.; let him not be released from the fetter of day-and-night. Of him now etc. etc.

verses.sa:
जितमस्माकमुद्भिन्नमस्माकमृतमस्माकं तेजोऽस्माकं ब्रह्मास्माकं स्वरस्माकं यज्ञोऽस्माकं पशवोऽस्माकं प्रजा अस्माकं वीरा अस्माकम् ।
तस्मादमुं निर्भजामोऽमुमामुष्यायणममुष्याः पुत्रमसौ यः ।
सोऽह्नोः संयतोः पाशान् मा मोचि ॥
verses.rom:
jitamasmakamudbhinnamasmakamritamasmakam tejo'smakam brahmasmakam svarasmakam yajno'smakam pashavo'smakam praja asmakam vira asmakam |
tasmadamum nirbhajamo'mumamushyayanamamushyah putramasau yah |
so'hnoh samyatoh pashan ma mochi ||
verses.en: 25. Ours is etc. etc.; let him not be released from the fetter of the two congruent (sam-yánt) days. Of him now etc. etc.

verses.sa:
जितमस्माकमुद्भिन्नमस्माकमृतमस्माकं तेजोऽस्माकं ब्रह्मास्माकं स्वरस्माकं यज्ञोऽस्माकं पशवोऽस्माकं प्रजा अस्माकं वीरा अस्माकम् ।
तस्मादमुं निर्भजामोऽमुमामुष्यायणममुष्याः पुत्रमसौ यः ।
स द्यावापृथिव्योः पाशान् मा मोचि ॥
verses.rom:
jitamasmakamudbhinnamasmakamritamasmakam tejo'smakam brahmasmakam svarasmakam yajno'smakam pashavo'smakam praja asmakam vira asmakam |
tasmadamum nirbhajamo'mumamushyayanamamushyah putramasau yah |
sa dyavaprithivyoh pashan ma mochi ||
verses.en: 26. Ours is etc. etc.; let him not be released from the fetter of heaven-and-earth. Of him now etc. etc.

verses.sa:
जितमस्माकमुद्भिन्नमस्माकमृतमस्माकं तेजोऽस्माकं ब्रह्मास्माकं स्वरस्माकं यज्ञोऽस्माकं पशवोऽस्माकं प्रजा अस्माकं वीरा अस्माकम् ।
तस्मादमुं निर्भजामोऽमुमामुष्यायणममुष्याः पुत्रमसौ यः ।
स इन्द्राग्न्योः पाशान् मा मोचि ॥
verses.rom:
jitamasmakamudbhinnamasmakamritamasmakam tejo'smakam brahmasmakam svarasmakam yajno'smakam pashavo'smakam praja asmakam vira asmakam |
tasmadamum nirbhajamo'mumamushyayanamamushyah putramasau yah |
sa indragnyoh pashan ma mochi ||
verses.en: 27. Ours is etc. etc.; let him not be released from the fetter of Indra-and-Agni. Of him now etc. etc.

verses.sa:
जितमस्माकमुद्भिन्नमस्माकमृतमस्माकं तेजोऽस्माकं ब्रह्मास्माकं स्वरस्माकं यज्ञोऽस्माकं पशवोऽस्माकं प्रजा अस्माकं वीरा अस्माकम् ।
तस्मादमुं निर्भजामोऽमुमामुष्यायणममुष्याः पुत्रमसौ यः ।
स मित्रावरुणयोः पाशान् मा मोचि ॥
verses.rom:
jitamasmakamudbhinnamasmakamritamasmakam tejo'smakam brahmasmakam svarasmakam yajno'smakam pashavo'smakam praja asmakam vira asmakam |
tasmadamum nirbhajamo'mumamushyayanamamushyah putramasau yah |
sa mitravarunayoh pashan ma mochi ||
verses.en: 28. Ours is etc. etc.; let him not be released from the fetter of Mitra-and-Varuṇa. Of him now etc. etc.

verses.sa:
जितमस्माकमुद्भिन्नमस्माकमृतमस्माकं तेजोऽस्माकं ब्रह्मास्माकं स्वरस्माकं यज्ञोऽस्माकं पशवोऽस्माकं प्रजा अस्माकं वीरा अस्माकम् ।
तस्मादमुं निर्भजामोऽमुमामुष्यायणममुष्याः पुत्रमसौ यः ।
स राज्ञो वरुणस्य पाशान् मा मोचि ॥
verses.rom:
jitamasmakamudbhinnamasmakamritamasmakam tejo'smakam brahmasmakam svarasmakam yajno'smakam pashavo'smakam praja asmakam vira asmakam |
tasmadamum nirbhajamo'mumamushyayanamamushyah putramasau yah |
sa rajno varunasya pashan ma mochi ||
verses.en: 29. Ours is etc. etc.; let him not be released from the fetter of king Varuṇa. Of him now etc. etc.

verses.sa: जितमस्माकमुद्भिन्नमस्माकमृतमस्माकं तेजोऽस्माकं ब्रह्मास्माकं स्वरस्माकं यज्ञोऽस्माकं पशवोऽस्माकं प्रजा अस्माकं वीरा अस्माकम् ॥
verses.rom: jitamasmakamudbhinnamasmakamritamasmakam tejo'smakam brahmasmakam svarasmakam yajno'smakam pashavo'smakam praja asmakam vira asmakam ||
verses.en: 30. Ours [is] what is conquered, ours what has shot up, ours right, ours brilliancy, ours bráhman, ours heaven, ours the sacrifice, ours cattle, ours progeny, ours heroes. 31. From that we disportion him yonder: so-and-so, of such-and-such lineage, son of such-and-such mother, who is yonder; 32. let him not be released from the fetter, the shackle of death. 33. Of him now I involve the splendor, brilliancy, breath, life-time; now I make him fall downward.

verses.sa: जितमस्माकमुद्भिन्नमस्माकमभ्यष्ठां विश्वाः पृतना अरातीः ॥
verses.rom: jitamasmakamudbhinnamasmakamabhyashtham vishvah pritana aratih ||
verses.en: Ours [is] what is conquered, ours what has shot up; I have withstood all fighters, niggards.

verses.sa: तदग्निराह तदु सोम आह पूषा मा धात्सुकृतस्य लोके ॥
verses.rom: tadagniraha tadu soma aha pusha ma dhatsukritasya loke ||
verses.en: That Agni says; that, too, Soma says: may Pūshan set me in the world of the well-done.

verses.sa: अगन्म स्वः स्वरगन्म सं सूर्यस्य ज्योतिषागन्म ॥
verses.rom: aganma svah svaraganma sam suryasya jyotishaganma ||
verses.en: We have gone to heaven (svàr); to heaven have we gone; we have united (sam-gam) with the sun's light;—

verses.sa: वस्योभूयाय वसुमान् यज्ञो वसु वंसिषीय वसुमान् भूयासं वसु मयि धेहि ॥
verses.rom: vasyobhuyaya vasuman yajno vasu vamsishiya vasuman bhuyasam vasu mayi dhehi ||
verses.en: In order to becoming better (vásyas-). Rich in good (vásu-) [is] the sacrifice; good may I win (van); rich in good may I be; good put thou in me.
